clause: Plugin scene-node access + node factories + events + quick-run + relaunch [STU-AUT-019]

scope.summary: Give plugins scene-node access ONLY through the typed object model (MT-487) and descriptor path (MT-485) - no privileged private plugin document model; node-factory commands to create new primitives (paths, text, frames, shapes, images, board objects); event subscription (run, selection-change, document-change, view-change, text-review, style-change, drop); typed parameter quick-run gathered from the command surface for headless runs; relaunch entry points pinned onto specific nodes.
acceptance_criteria: plugin scene access via typed model+descriptor only; factories/events/quick-run/relaunch; no private model
expected_tests: live: plugin creates a primitive via node-factory command (promotion-gated)
test: plugin event subscription fires on document-change
negative: plugin cannot access a private document model

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Plugin scene access, factories & events (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Plugins get a privileged private model or unreachable extension points.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
